_comment: seo-coach auto-summon router for Claude Code. MERGE these two entries into the existing hooks object of ~/.claude/settings.json (global, all projects) or .claude/settings.json (one project). Do not replace the file — if you already have UserPromptSubmit hooks, append to that array. Replace <SKILL_DIR> with the folder containing seo_coach_router.py, e.g. C:/Users/you/.claude/skills/seo-coach/hooks or ~/.claude/skills/seo-coach/hooks
